title: EDIFACT partner overrides
description: The rules a trading partner, or one flow with a partner, changes in the standard definitions of an EDIFACT directory, without editing the registry (contracts/registry): stricter or looser data elements, positions made mandatory or conditional, code-list additions and removals, structure cardinalities and issue severities. A document is for one directory and applies to the messages of that directory; several documents are applied in order, the last one winning. Unlike the other contracts its objects are closed: a misspelt or unknown property is an error, not a rule that is silently not applied. Rules that need the registry, such as a position that must exist, are listed in contracts/overrides/README.md.

$schema.description: The schema this document follows, for editors. Never read by a program.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this format. Readers refuse a version they do not know.

name.description: A name for people: the partner and the flow, for example "Acme orders from Retailer". Never read by a program.

description.description: Why the rules are there. Never read by a program.

directory.description: The directory the document is for, as the registry gives it (the three parts of S009 of UNH). The document changes the registry of this directory and no other.

dataElements.description: Rules of simple data elements, by tag. A property that is given replaces the one of the registry; the others stay. Every use of the element is changed, in every segment and composite.

additionalProperties.description: What changes in a data element.

type.description: a: alphabetic, n: numeric, an: alphanumeric.

composites.description: Rules of composite data elements, by tag. A composite is shared by every segment that uses it, so a change applies wherever it is used.

status.description: M makes the component mandatory where its composite is present, C makes it conditional.

segments.description: Rules of the positions of segments, by tag. The change applies wherever the segment is used.

elements.description: Elements by position, counted from 1; an empty element counts and a composite counts as one.

additionalProperties.description: What changes in a position of a segment.

status.description: M: mandatory, at least one occurrence. C: conditional, may be absent.

maxOccurs.description: Largest number of repetitions of the element (syntax version 4).

codeLists.description: Changes to code lists, by identifier.

additionalProperties.description: What changes in a code list.

closed.description: true: the list holds every valid value, so another value is an error. false: it is only what the directory knows, so another value is at most a warning, and only when the validator is run with all the code lists. Added and removed codes only change what is enforced on a list that is closed.

add.description: Codes the partner uses that the list does not have, by code. Has an effect on a closed list (or an open one when the validator checks all lists).

remove.description: Codes the partner does not accept. Has an effect on a closed list (or an open one when the validator checks all lists).

messages.description: Changes to message structures, by message type.

nodes.description: Nodes of the structure, selected by a TAG (every segment node of that tag, at any depth), by a group identifier SGn (that group) or by SGn/TAG (the segment nodes of that tag directly inside that group). Where several selectors match one node, each property comes from the most specific one: SGn/TAG over TAG.

additionalProperties.description: What changes in a node. For a group it is the group, not its trigger.

status.description: M: mandatory, at least one occurrence. C: conditional, may be absent.

severity.description: The severity of an issue, by code: error, warning, or off, which drops the issue. A code is changed wherever the validator finds it, in every layer that uses it (MISSING_MANDATORY_ELEMENT and INVALID_DATA_TYPE are also found in the envelope segments). The codes of the files that cannot be read (layer tokenizer) cannot be changed.
